purpose: Legally usable orthogonal aerial imagery for the fixed KBDU standalone Quest terrain texture footprint

selection_basis: The official ArcGIS item is public and carries an explicit CC0 1.0 Universal dedication.
The item describes 9-inch orthogonal imagery captured in Spring and Summer 2020.
The cached service covers the full existing 24 km local footprint and exposes reviewed LOD 15 through 18 tiles.
Its reviewed cache samples are materially denser and newer than the existing 2019 USGS NAIP fallback at KBDU.
decision.legal_review_note: This engineering rights audit records publisher metadata and license links; it is not legal advice. Re-review if the pinned item revision, service contract, or use scope changes.

candidates.title: 2020 Imagery
candidates.acquisition_period: Spring and Summer 2020; exact frame dates are not published in the item
candidates.nominal_source_resolution: 9 inches (0.2286 m), as stated by the publisher
candidates.runtime_cache_samples: ArcGIS Web Mercator cached MIXED/JPEG tiles; LOD 15, 16, 17, and 18 only
candidates.credit: City of Boulder; source imagery produced by Pictometry International (2020)
use_constraints: Visual context only; not current airport, survey, or navigation data.
Do not imply publisher or producer endorsement.
Do not infer 0.2286 m runtime detail from coarser selected cache LODs.
Retain the exact item, service, tile, derivative, and tool hashes in the handoff manifest.

candidates.title: 2024 Aerial City of Boulder
candidates.decision_reason: The inspected item and service did not publish an imagery-specific license or sufficient credit/rights terms. Newer pixels do not override the repository's binary-source license requirement.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for catalog data, subject to each dataset record

candidates.decision_reason: The inspected official open-data group did not expose a suitable orthophoto item with source-specific rights and resolution metadata for this milestone. Generic basemap imagery was not treated as licensed source imagery.
Legally usable, but older and not a fidelity improvement over the selected explicit-CC0 2020 source for the KBDU footprint.

candidates.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / U.S. Department of Agriculture
candidates.acquisition_date: 2019-09-19 for the existing KBDU source tile
candidates.decision_reason: The unchanged existing texture is used only as a geospatial alignment reference. The selected 2020 City source is newer and has denser reviewed cache samples around the airport.

prohibited_sources: Commercial basemap imagery without an explicit redistribution/modification license
Any aerial source whose publisher, acquisition date/range, or rights cannot be recorded
